verse.verse_1: (O Prophet), Did We not lay open your breast
verse.verse_2: and relieve you of the burden
verse.verse_3: that had well-nigh broken your back?
verse.verse_4: And did We not exalt your fame?
verse.verse_5: Indeed, there is ease with hardship.
verse.verse_6: Most certainly, there is ease with hardship.
verse.verse_7: So, whenever you are free, strive in devotion,
verse.verse_8: and turn to your Lord with longing.
